summary: Tangipahoa Parish lookout listed by Central US Lookouts; the map point's edit note calls it a communication mast, so its identity is doubtful.

first steel fire tower 1922 near Bogalusa
evidence.quote: In 1922 the first steel fire tower was built near Bogalusa on Great Southern Lumber Company land.
By 1943 thirty-nine fire towers had been built and by 1950 the number had increased to fifty-six.

evidence.supports: many towers inactive, some kept in reserve
evidence.quote: Many fire towers still exist with the majority being inactive but many are maintained in reserve.

notes_for_editor: Possible identity error for human review. The OSM point carries a lookout name and lattice observation tags, but its version 3 changeset comment reads 'Add/modify communication mast.' Searches for Hammond surfaced only modern communications structures (search snippets, not read pages), and towerdex pages return HTTP 403. The Central US Lookouts index gives Hammond Lookout Tower in Tangipahoa Parish with no detail page (hammond.html and hammond1.html both return 404). Ordinary Iowa Environmental Mesonet climate stations named HAMMOND (LA4034, 1892-2010) and HAMMOND 5 E (LA4030, 1981-2014) are not linked here. Consider kind and hidden after review; the brief's record is not changed.
